name: Realm First! race/class achievements grant their CharTitles title (#9530, #9531)
contract: Achievement 86207 'Realm First! Level 60 Night Elf Reaper' and achievement 86056 'Realm First! Level 60 Undead Witch Hunter' complete on reaching level 60 as that race/class (achievement_criteria_data type 21, S_PLAYER_CLASS_RACE). Before the fix neither had an achievement_reward row, so completing them granted the achievement but no title. CharTitles.dbc 115 is '%s, Champion of Elune' (Alliance) and 119 is '%s the Forsaken' (Horde); achievement_reward now sets TitleA=115 for 86207 and TitleH=119 for 86056.

steps.label: Night Elf Reaper earns the realm-first achievement
